title: Notification badge
summary: An absolute child placed relative to a position: relative parent.
explanation: position: absolute takes an element out of the flow and places it relative to its nearest positioned ancestor. position: relative on the avatar makes it that ancestor without moving it.
Negative offsets let the badge hang over the corner.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .avatar: the badge jumps to the page corner.
Replace top and right with inset: auto -6px -6px auto.
